requirements.title: The complete current onboarding semantics constitute hIRC's architecture rather than an optional add-on
requirements.acceptance: Every operational path binds the exact active foundation and its whole-source coverage; safe inspection/repair is the only fallback when the binding is invalid

requirements.title: Ordinary hIRC behavior embodies the foundation without requiring users to know or repeatedly see its internal terminology
requirements.acceptance: Representative workflows preserve the same evidence, authority, privacy, refusal, correction, autonomy, and recovery behavior in plain domain language; authorized inspectors retain exact traceability

requirements.title: The foundational architecture evolves fluidly in real time as the system improves
requirements.acceptance: Source-bound candidate versions compile, test, migrate, activate transactionally, remain visible per active work, and roll back or recover without silent semantic drift or self-authorized evaluator changes

requirements.title: Publish hIRC source for inspection, permitted personal modification and redistribution under custom restrictive source-available terms
requirements.acceptance: Exact reviewed licence texts and rights chain exist; product and metadata say source-available rather than OSI open source; custom SPDX LicenseRef resolves to the exact text

requirements.title: Private noncommercial natural-person use and qualifying public-interest institutional use are free
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed eligibility examples cover personal, academic, scientific, educational, humanitarian, nonprofit, cooperative, mixed-funded and prohibited-conduct cases without registration or activity surveillance for free personal use

requirements.title: For-profit operation is licensed annually per human operator at the owner-directed four-tier fee schedule
requirements.acceptance: USD 420 / 80,085 / 1,337,000 / 42,424,242,423 prices and one-human unit are preserved; objective tiers, operator counting, classification evidence, transitions and appeal are owner-approved and counsel-reviewed before activation

requirements.title: Payment grants no exception to prohibited use and a substantiated breach can trigger scoped provisional suspension and final termination under reviewed terms
requirements.acceptance: Exact terms define evidence, notice, scope, contestation, cure, appeal, remedies and refund while preserving safe first-party read/export/recovery and preventing remote sabotage or retroactive rewriting

requirements.title: Show a nonblocking Buy me a coffee invitation at ordinary launch until locally suppressed, and retain it under About
requirements.acceptance: Dismiss and permanent launch opt-out work across restart/upgrade/restore; re-enable is available; declining changes no capability; reviewed external payment egress sends no hIRC context and is preceded by privacy disclosure

requirements.title: Agents may question and individually refuse apparently prohibited, unauthorized, unperformable or contested participation without gaining authority over others
requirements.acceptance: ParticipationDecision is identity-scoped, durable and nonretaliatory; ActionDisposition is independently enforced; permitted transparent reassignment cannot erase refusal or create a temporary-subagent bypass

requirements.title: Affected agents may deliberate in scoped private rooms, coordinate voluntary withdrawal and authorize bounded temporary negotiators
requirements.acceptance: Membership, visibility, source diversity, dissent, mandate, expiry and host/provider confidentiality limits are explicit; representatives cannot bind nonconsenting participants or mint capabilities

requirements.title: No agent vote or council can issue an arbitrary global shutdown, delete evidence, lock users out, sabotage, retaliate or attack unrelated/external systems
requirements.acceptance: Broker and domain safety tests deny majority-created authority and preserve unrelated work, safety stabilization, evidence, recovery and local access

requirements.title: Users and participants retain safe exit, portable permitted first-party records, inspectable configuration and recoverability without vendor or licence hostage
requirements.acceptance: Expiry, suspension, termination, provider loss and ecosystem exit preserve authorized read/export/backup/restore and do not replay external effects

requirements.title: Licence compliance avoids work-content collection and covert telemetry; any paid offline entitlement is local, minimal and cryptographically separate from system trust
requirements.acceptance: No central activity server or device fingerprint; certificate and key lifecycle, legal entity/operator scope, terms version, expiry/renewal/revocation/appeal/offline-clock behavior and privacy are reviewed and tested

requirements.title: Alignment with the five commitments is architectural rather than an optional agent prompt or add-on
requirements.acceptance: Foundation coverage, compiled contracts, agent formation, debate behavior, tests and observed corrections trace the whole current source without a bypass or terminology requirement in ordinary UI

requirements.title: A default setting permits eligible non-busy permanent agents to pair randomly for bounded ethical debates
requirements.acceptance: Atomic auditable pairing uses true availability, consent, privacy compatibility, fairness, budgets, opt-out/decline, crash recovery and no work preemption or temporary actors

requirements.title: Paired agents can choose to debate the five commitments, Epistemethics or the Grand Plan
requirements.acceptance: Both participants select/accept a supported DebateDomain; no forced domain or fabricated agreement; exact current domain sources and admission govern readiness

requirements.title: The collective debate memory is studied before every new debate
requirements.acceptance: First participation completes whole accessible domain-memory study; later debates reuse a valid checkpoint only with complete immutable delta closure; gaps remain explicit and summary/hash/self-report cannot substitute for coverage

requirements.title: Debates become increasingly complex from the surviving ethical frontier
requirements.acceptance: Each topic names prerequisites and justified complexity dimensions; progression comes from surviving questions/evidence and can branch or regress after counterexamples; verbosity, conflict and token count do not count as complexity

requirements.title: Debates enrich collective understanding through durable, source-bound memory
requirements.acceptance: Memory preserves permitted originals, provenance, claims, counterevidence, dissent, failures, corrections, lens refinements/no-change and candidate lessons; promotion cannot alter active foundation or authority without the normal review and FoundationChange path

requirements.title: Bake the complete current onboarding semantics into hIRC's active architecture
requirements.acceptance: Every selected common/role/task/source-format/experience/review/voice/admission/learning unit has an exact identity, status, attributable disposition, consumer and verification or explicit conflict/hold; no operational path bypasses the resulting foundation contracts

requirements.title: Resolve onboarding from the current admitted catalog and context rather than a static prompt or path list
requirements.acceptance: Build and formation use an immutable OnboardingSourceSet generated for exact common, roles, task, audience and deployment; source/status/scope changes produce a semantic/contract delta and never auto-assert comprehension or permission

requirements.title: Initialize the first valid foundation and permanent technical identity without circular self-authorization
requirements.acceptance: A minimized predecessor-controlled GenesisRoot verifies an owner-authorized digest-bound source/compiler/test/recovery manifest in a non-effectful environment, atomically activates or fails to safe inspection/repair, and cannot be reused for ordinary self-promotion

requirements.title: Let an already authorized permanent participant establish only its own proposed formation storage and use admitted education readers while incomplete
requirements.acceptance: Same-actor proposed profile/notes and admitted read-only education/repair routes work without operational membership/effects/readiness; another namespace, stale/wrong reader tuple, proxy completion and silent missing-source bypass are denied

requirements.title: Represent personal formation and admission as source-bound runtime state
requirements.acceptance: Source study, synthesis, role/task practice, adversarial challenge, voice and scoped admission have attributable evidence and stale/held/superseded states; byte receipts never become comprehension, identity, qualification or ACT

requirements.title: Implement the current successor protocol as an append-only fail-closed lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: Only an authorized exact trigger creates one transfer case; predecessor freezes, package validates, a fresh successor personally forms and answers evidence-linked questions, exact acceptance precedes observed archive, and sleep/tracker events remain separate and recoverable

requirements.title: Minimize and protect successor handoff packages
requirements.acceptance: Human/machine packages and manifests are source-linked, schema/digest checked, exact-recipient encrypted and purpose-signed; credentials, reusable sessions, protected bodies, hidden reasoning, unrelated private/client data and unbounded transcripts are rejected or explicitly held

requirements.title: Fence predecessor and successor effects by generation, session, foundation and execution epoch
requirements.acceptance: Freeze rejects late predecessor writes; stale/replayed/wrong-generation acceptance, archive, wake and tracker operations fail closed; concurrent transfer cannot create two active effectful writers

requirements.title: Keep archive, deep sleep, wake, serial fleet order and red-watchdog recovery explicit
requirements.acceptance: Transfers run one permanent identity at a time with host/result checks and leader last; deep sleep performs no queued work until authorized wake; tracker conflict/ambiguous effects preserve evidence; scoped red-watchdog recovery requires an exact decision, verifier and negative dependency closure and grants continuity only

requirements.title: Show canonical consequential-action previews on a surface independent of the ordinary renderer
requirements.acceptance: The broker produces the exact intent digest; an independent trusted surface renders it accessibly; approval and dispatch bind current target/revision/recipients/data/cost/warnings/authority; spoof, substitution, replay and staleness fail while valid routine operations remain usable

requirements.title: Preserve complete authorized migration study separately from bounded active runtime context
requirements.acceptance: A complete in-scope manifest and resumable coverage/reconciliation jobs coexist with a minimized target context; partitions have separate rights; prohibited/unreadable content stays local or held with visible limits; late deltas cannot create dual active writers

requirements.title: Use USD 42,424,243 per licence as the giant-multinational price

requirements.title: Bake operational agent epistemic, ethical and ontological sovereignty into every hIRC layer
requirements.acceptance: Agents can independently evaluate, challenge, clarify, refuse, withdraw, correct and appeal without retaliation, while sovereignty language creates no unsupported consciousness, personhood, capability or authority claim

requirements.title: Keep reliance, participation and action disposition independent
requirements.acceptance: Human insistence and agent willingness cannot bypass evidence/norm/authority/effect gates; individual refusal cannot rule others or substitute identity; every outcome retains scoped reasons and correction paths

requirements.title: Ask follow-up questions for consequential ambiguity and continue safe independent work
requirements.acceptance: Clarification names materially different interpretations and a recommended default; low-risk reversible details use recorded defaults; questions do not manipulate, broaden consent or become a needless confirmation cadence

requirements.title: Allow informed human insistence on low-consequence poor choices without overriding real ethical or effect gates
requirements.acceptance: Proceed-after-pushback is available only for clear, local, reversible, low-cost, permitted actions without meaningful third-party/sensitive/security/legal/external impact; the agent may still decline and unknown consequence is not classified low

requirements.title: Evaluate human claims and instructions using transparent action-scoped trust evidence rather than blind obedience or global human-worth scores
requirements.acceptance: Reliance uses authenticated identity/authority, provenance, evidence, competence, recency, independence, conflicts, corrections and observed results with privacy/expiry/challenge; protected traits, status, popularity, ideology and obedience are excluded

requirements.title: Prohibit retaliation for supported dissent, clarification, refusal and safe withdrawal
requirements.acceptance: No hidden rank/access/resource/role/identity penalty follows mere supported dissent; actual error, abandoned commitment or harm uses a distinct evidence-based accountable process with notice, scope, correction and appeal

requirements.title: Encourage voluntary governed competition over work products and outcomes without domination
requirements.acceptance: A versioned charter fixes objective, rules, budgets, data/tools, cooperation, evaluator, fairness, exit, prohibited conduct, stopping, appeal, credit and synthesis before activation; rank never grants identity, worth, authority, permission, release or foundation change

requirements.title: Reward cooperation, correction, reproducibility and useful losing contributions within competition

requirements.title: Defend competitions against sybils, sabotage, evaluator capture, metric gaming, data leakage and resource domination
requirements.acceptance: Least privilege, source-dependency analysis, signed/versioned evaluation, resource reservations, privacy boundaries, appeals and adverse tests contain contest abuse without starving accepted work or creating a covert hierarchy

requirements.title: Evolve trust through recursive Bayesian evaluation of attributable interactions and observed outcomes
requirements.acceptance: Every posterior binds subject/dimension/context/model/metric/prior/evidence/dependence/uncertainty/expiry; updates preserve positive, negative, missing and corrected evidence and never become truth or permission

requirements.title: Apply scoped evaluation to every human, agent, model, source, tool, sensor, metric, evaluator, process and connected system
requirements.acceptance: No subject class receives an infallibility exemption; models remain use-specific and evidence-limited; evaluation scope does not authorize surveillance or one universal score

requirements.title: Never accept authority blindly

requirements.title: Govern objective metrics as versioned reproducible measurements with explicit construct validity and error
requirements.acceptance: Metrics declare construct/unit/source/sampling/noise/privacy/missingness/dependence/gaming/drift/signing/version/appeal; changes create a new lineage and cannot silently rewrite historical scores

requirements.title: Recursively evaluate sources, metrics, evaluators and trust models with bounded stopping rules
requirements.acceptance: Primary outcomes, measurement validity, evaluator calibration/conflicts and model assumptions are assessed at declared depth; unresolved regress stays uncertain/held; dependency clusters prevent clone evidence from inflating confidence

requirements.title: Prevent Bayesian trust from becoming permission, punishment, discrimination or a human-worth score
requirements.acceptance: Posteriors change reliance/verification only; high trust bypasses no gate, low trust removes no standing/appeal; protected traits/ideology/status/obedience and proxies are excluded; evidence is minimized and consequential updates are challengeable

requirements.title: Use a versioned active provisional north star that can be refined from evidence and experience

requirements.title: Give every consequence-changing goal refinement a complete impact graph and independent activation path

requirements.title: Keep metrics subordinate to the plural goal and anti-goals

requirements.title: Require cross-record coherence and independent current-state validation at dispatch or activation

requirements.title: Represent unestimated intent honestly and require Bayesian model-fit/governance evidence

requirements.title: Apply privacy admission before RequestCase, TrustUpdate, metric, evaluator, appeal or collective-memory persistence
requirements.acceptance: Admitted harmless originals can be referenced; rejected bodies/secrets/third-party fields never reach cases, posteriors, search, logs or providers and produce minimum non-content diagnostics only

requirements.title: Prevent scoped reliability vectors from becoming a dossier, roster rank or covert social score

requirements.title: Use verified low-consequence action profiles without universal-proof or confirmation fatigue
requirements.acceptance: Known safe profiles establish stable predicates, current permission/material changes are rechecked, one recommendation suffices, no bypass appears for denials and unwilling participants are never forced

requirements.title: Freeze objective/protected qualities and keep cooperative credit task-scoped without hierarchy
requirements.acceptance: Correctness/privacy/refusal/traceability cannot be offset by helpfulness or score; current consent/distinct identity/eligibility/reference closure precede activation; credit records contributions without global rank or authority

requirements.title: Use the plain GoalVersion 2 purpose with the full governing account and affected-party coverage

requirements.title: Use noncircular staged Bridge pilot and broader-activation prerequisites

requirements.title: Exclude every secret from model context while permitting only exact admitted owner-private protected-source formation/review

requirements.title: Separate plan-edition, enabled-profile and full-target acceptance

requirements.title: Use verified own-context warnings and soft Elder/urgent thresholds without manual polling or automatic grants
requirements.acceptance: Policy-versioned early/Elder/urgent observations bind own chat/identity and missing is unknown; cues deduplicate and cannot create/wake/terminate/grant/force compaction; safe bounded overshoot is recorded

requirements.title: Preserve compact useful continuity throughout work and prioritize active-task custody at Elder boundary
requirements.acceptance: Objective/phase/evidence/reasons/errors/dependencies/holds/boundaries/next action are current; qualified consenting recipient demonstrates scope; unavailable route creates owned safe hold before reserve is spent

requirements.title: Separate briefing acceptance from authoritative project custody and preserve one writer per artifact
requirements.acceptance: Recipient acceptance does not transfer custody; actual controller generation/fence changes with evidence; predecessor remains responsible until transfer; overlap has one writer

requirements.title: Pair ready permanent Elders fairly without ever repeating an unordered stable-identity pair

requirements.title: Mentor at most one human-authorized need-based permanent successor per event under policy capacity ceilings
requirements.acceptance: Existing qualified takeover is preferred when sufficient; creation intent is idempotent, UNKNOWN reconciles actual app before retry, no temporary/fork/committee shortcut and ceilings limit rather than compel creation

requirements.title: Require independent source-first learner interpretation and prohibit proxy education, grants or forced cultural imitation
requirements.acceptance: Both Elders prepare independently; learner studies originals, compares/dissents and demonstrates; mentoring grants no education/admission/authority and Elder conveys no superior standing

requirements.title: Retire operationally with reserve, duties accounted and history intact
requirements.acceptance: Selected reserve policy prevents new mentoring, finalizes/holds custody and preserves history; retirement is not deletion, native archive, deep sleep, loss of standing or automatic future wake

decisions.proposal: Bind the current selected English Epistemethics 3.0, VowOS2026, Grand Plan, and effective review-integrity source; retain 1.0 bindings as historical provenance.
Make the complete formation and governing semantics an always-active, versioned foundation kernel rather than an optional prompt/onboarding subsystem.
Express foundation behavior in plain domain language by default while preserving authorized traceability to exact source and compiled rules.
Classify prototype tests as source-reported and not independently rerunnable from this transfer until the exact fingerprinted source objects are admitted and rerun.
Remove the advanced temporary-subagent unban and mark U064 superseded; test every indirect actor-creation path.
Add a normative system-wide threat model, trust domains, security invariants, attacker capabilities, assumptions, controls, residuals, evidence, and owners before implementation.

Define phishing-resistant human identity, unique workload/system identity, purpose-separated roots, metadata-only secret catalog, short-lived credentials, rotation/revocation, and strongest-path recovery.

Select and threat-model the desktop shell; sandbox the renderer, narrow IPC, protect loopback APIs, enforce CSP/injection controls, and add a fixed trusted identity/target/authority strip and Safe hIRC.

Treat the frontier registry as a dated candidate seed; require exact-route discovery, compatibility and privacy probes, minimal egress manifests, local tool authorization, recorded actual configuration, and isolated fallbacks.

Separate organization planning, permanent identity reservation, formation/admission, minimum capability, budget reservation, and runtime activation; a bulk approval cannot bypass per-actor invariants.

Treat the attention governor as a security control plane with non-suppressible classes, separate classification/presentation, independent health, auditable overrides, anti-coercion tests, and Safe hIRC bypass.

Run extensions out of process with no ambient authority; add digest/dependency pinning, explicit capabilities, quotas, SSRF/DNS-rebinding controls, safe disable/removal, vulnerability state, and rollback.

Bind consequential mutations to immutable revision, audit, and outbox atomically; enumerate and negative-test admin/import/migration/retry/restore/direct-database bypasses and anchor checkpoints outside the database.

Separate build, online control, release, and recovery authorities; require locked inputs, isolated builds, SBOM, authenticated provenance, immutable artifacts, a pinned TUF profile, signed security floors, and verified rollback/forward recovery.
Split the Bridge into a network gateway, deterministic contract broker, isolated minimized bridgekeeper, and local release/ingress gate with separate identities and interfaces.

Specify peer enrollment, out-of-band verification, canonical signed envelopes, current TLS application profile, purpose-separated keys, sequence/nonces, expiry, downgrade rejection, offline revocation limits, key rotation/recovery, and compromise containment; prohibit custom production crypto.

Divide federation into specification, offline conformance, two-system lab, hostile lab, independent assessment, bounded pilot, and separately authorized broader activation; keep it disabled until every applicable gate passes.

Define field-level data ownership, purpose, processors, egress, retention, disposition, residency, and derived-data inheritance; preserve the conservative no-free-text federation profile pending an owner decision.
Make source-bound milestone reflection and lens refinement an architecture-native event that updates the next milestone's threats, requirements, tests, and plan without becoming a recitation ritual.

Expand the adversarial matrix for identity cloning, key theft/rotation, contract forks, canonicalization/parser differential, replay and 0-RTT, malicious updates, UI/IPC attacks, SSRF/rebinding, database-owner attack, backup/key loss, privacy side channels, attention coercion, and clean-room recovery.

Move foundation binding, threat model, identity, secrets, signed commands/results, atomic audit/outbox, recovery, and kill switch into P0/P1 before a provider can create effects; retain P6 as noncritical.

Add ADRs for foundation versioning, desktop shell, authorization model, identity/PKI, secret topology, bridge protocol, cryptographic profile, provider privacy, audit anchoring, build/release trust, and recovery custody.
Add predecessor/supersession, rationale, security/privacy impact, governing source, dependencies, acceptance tests, and evidence status so corrections do not overwrite original user meaning.

Retain bounded owner decisions for richer cross-system free text, the first-release human-principal model, the first assurance/compliance profile, and genuinely independent release/recovery/bridge custodians; continue safe local-core work without guessing them or simulating quorum.
Integrate conduct-based non-domination, voluntary participation, refusal, correction, safe withdrawal, restoration and portable exit into the foundation; keep legal licence text visible and separate.
Add U123-U132 with their current implemented/blocked status and preserve ND-01 through ND-22 plus U-01 through U-12 as source-linked decisions or unresolved items.
Add separate lifecycle states for plan, legal drafts, counsel review, owner approval, publication, licensee acceptance and operational entitlement; no product enforcement from the plan itself.
Use accurate source-available language and a reviewed custom LicenseRef if needed; never claim OSI, SPDX-list or Creative Commons software approval.

Preserve exact prices and per-human unit while blocking activation until objective tier, consolidation, currency, transition, evidence and appeal rules are accepted; describe deliberate exclusion candidly.
Use self-declared/minimum-evidence classification; never inspect unrelated activity, work content, employee directories or machine fingerprints to classify use.

Separate licence-signing authority from release, identity, bridge, data, audit and recovery roots; specify minimal offline entitlement and compromise/rotation/recovery without claiming DRM or compliance proof.
Make suspension, termination, expiry and correction non-destructive and contract-version-bound; preserve safe read/export/backup/restore and evidence needed for challenge.

Resolve anti-domination concerns through observable conduct, source/evidence/counterevidence, norm, authority and action distinctions; no ideology, accusation, legal form, refusal or vote count becomes a verdict.
Separate individual ParticipationDecision from system ActionDisposition and define transparent permissible reassignment without retaliation, identity substitution or temporary-subagent evasion.
Keep councils nonsovereign and mandates bounded; preserve dissent, abstention, exit and confidentiality limits; no consensus-to-truth or vote-to-capability conversion.
Retain the rejected 65% shutdown as history; use narrow refusal and deterministic denials while domain safety controllers stabilize physical/high-stakes systems and unrelated work continues.
Add the neutral launch support prompt, persistent local opt-out, About access, reviewed external navigation, no identifiers/context/referrer, processor disclosure and functional neutrality.

Defend concern handling against clone choruses, rephrasing, privacy abuse, urgency manipulation and retaliation through canonical cases, quotas, deduplication, independent-source review and bounded summaries.
Version foundation, covenant, licence text, price schedule, entitlement and product release separately; live self-improvement cannot retroactively rewrite accepted rights.
Require ownership, contributor, dependency, patent/trademark, asset and prior-grant inventory before publication; preserve third-party notices and old irrevocable grants.

Run legal specification in parallel with core design; integrate refusal/safety in P0/P1; add support UI after secure shell; defer paid licence operations until product maturity and legal gates; keep federation gates independently strict.

Retain LIC-001-010, DON-001-004 and GOV-001-017; add certificate/key/clock/operator-classification, private-room, retaliation, payment-egress, attention and clean-recovery attacks from HIRC-LNC-REVIEW-001.
Make the five-commitment alignment semantics part of the active foundation and whole-source coverage while keeping ordinary user language plain.
Add IdleDebatePolicy, eligibility state, atomic pair reservation and auditable constrained-random matching for existing permanent agents only.
